title: Notifications
description: Sends the human a notification on the map, needing no approval: made by the write root as the one who sends it (root.notify), and told to the packs that hear it; whom it may mail is the walls' recipient gate (packs/walls/kernel/notify-mail.ts). Other internal packs notify by its name, act.report.notify. A server-level service: versioned and pinned with the server by its operator, never turned on, off or versioned per island.
